title: 2025-08-21 Surprise gacha and schedule-trust incident
source: A gacha was suddenly added on Aug 21 although the August schedule only listed the Miku event and Tanabata live for Aug 23; unlike the JP counterpart it omitted regular limited cards, shrinking the selector pool. Players renamed themselves in rankings after the Aug 25 event to protest, and an Aug 31 Miku birthday notice contained a 'subject to change without notice' phrase. (Source: NGA community reports)
